data.one_liner: Provides widgets to clip and border content with regular polygon shapes
data.what_it_does: The package offers a ClipPolygon widget to clip child widgets into a regular polygon and a PolygonBorder shape for buttons and other widgets. It supports custom side count, border radius, rotation, shadows and borders.
use_when: You need to clip a widget into a regular polygon shape
You want a button or container with a polygonal border
You need simple, declarative polygon styling without custom painting
avoid_when: You require irregular or dynamic polygon shapes
You need advanced animation or physics for polygons
strengths: Supports border radius, rotation, shadows and borders
weaknesses: No support for irregular or dynamic polygons
